runs.name: fraction-dense-180k
runs.notes: The two things that worked tonight, together: the budget drawn as a share of what was predicted, and the densest field the card holds over at most six context views. The share run spent 619 steps retrying out of memory, all of them in the corner where a high share meets many views, so the regime it was built to cover is the one it kept losing. Six views is what lets the high shares actually run.
